login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to your NexusPanel workspace

overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: Your control center
overview.description: Pick a path below to get started, or check live stats. Each section in the menu does one job — you won't get lost.
overview.pickPath: What do you want to do?
overview.pathProxySteps: 1. Create inbound → 2. Add user → 3. Share link
overview.pathWgSteps: 1. Add WG server → 2. Add user → 3. Download .conf
overview.pathTunnelSteps: 1. Add exit server → 2. Create tunnel → 3. Apply
overview.lowWalletHint: Contact your provider to top up — user renewals may fail until credited.
overview.mrrDesc: Last {{days}} days — charges from reseller wallets
overview.noActiveUsersBwHint: No active or online users. Live speeds are not subscription traffic — usually port scans, OS updates, or the panel itself.
overview.healthInboundsOk: At least one inbound is ready
overview.healthInboundsNo: Add when you want to offer Xray protocols on this panel

hub.serversDesc: Foreign nodes, WireGuard, Hysteria2/TUIC, tunnels and dedicated IPs — all in one place.
hub.connectionDesc: Xray inbounds, outbounds, routing rules, subscription hosts, and (in expert mode) DNS / raw JSON.
hub.businessDesc: Invoices, resellers, usage stats and automation.
hub.inboundHintBody: Inbounds are optional. A fresh install starts with none — add a listener (e.g. VLESS on 443) when you need one, then create users.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Manage subscriptions and access
users.description: Create and manage everyone who uses your VPN. Each user picks one or more protocols (VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks), gets a data limit and an expiry date, and receives a subscription URL. Click a row for a deep-dive with QR codes and one-tap import.
users.templatesDesc: Preset data limits and expiry for quick user creation.
users.templateHint: Protocols and limits come from the selected template.
users.importApplyConfirm: Import {{n}} new user(s) from the file?
users.importNothingNew: No new users to import in this file
users.importTruncated: Preview shows first 2000 rows; import applies the full file
users.importMapTitle: Map foreign inbound tags to this panel
users.importFmtMarzban: Marzban / NexusPanel / PasarGuard: Settings → Export users (JSON), or backup with users[]
users.importFmt3xui: 3x-ui: Panel backup JSON (inbounds with clients) or inbound export
users.importFmtCsv: CSV: username, protocols, limit_gb, expire, note
users.importFmtLinks: Links: .txt with one vless/vmess/trojan/ss:// link per line
users.subUrlHintTitle: Two links — don't mix them up
users.subUrlHintBody: VPN apps (v2rayNG, V2Box, Hiddify) need the /sub/… URL below. The /subscribe/ page is for browsers only.
users.wgHint: Keys and peer IP are generated automatically. Download the .conf from user details.
users.hy2Hint: Hysteria2 credentials are auto-generated. Requires a node with Hysteria2 enabled (sing-box).
users.tuicHint: TUIC credentials are auto-generated. Requires a node with TUIC enabled. Often blocked inside Iran.
users.wizardPickProtoHint: Tap cards to toggle — multiple protocols allowed.
users.noProtocolsAvailableHint: Create an inbound under Connection → Inbounds, or enable WireGuard / Hysteria2 / TUIC on a node first.
users.singboxNoHy2: No Hysteria2-enabled node — enable H2 on a server first (Add node or Sing-box page).
users.singboxNoTuic: No TUIC-enabled node on this panel.
users.wgNoNode: No WireGuard-enabled node — add or provision a WG node first.
users.awgHint: AmneziaWG obfuscated peer on port 51821 — download .conf from user details.
users.awgNoNode: No AmneziaWG-enabled node — enable AWG on a WireGuard node first.
users.inboundRequired: Select at least one inbound for {{proto}}
users.ssInboundMismatch: Cipher does not match this inbound (legacy vs SS-2022)
users.resetAllUsageConfirm: Reset traffic counters for ALL users and restart cores?
users.templateInboundsHint: Optional — applied when creating users from this template
users.portalCreateHint: Set an initial portal password so the user can renew at /portal/
users.revokeSubConfirm: Revoke subscription links? The user must refresh clients.
users.clientProfileHint: Tunes protocol order and node selection for compatible client apps. No effect on standard apps.
users.portalPasswordHint: User signs in at /portal/ with VPN username + this password
users.portalPasswordPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep current password
users.sellPlanEmpty: No plans in your catalog. Create one under Billing → Plans.

infra.title: Infrastructure
infra.subtitle: Nodes, regions and secure tunnels
infra.description: The physical and logical layer of your network. Nodes are the servers running Xray. Inbounds are the protocols those servers expose. Hosts control the address and TLS your users see. Tunnels relay traffic from an in-country node to a foreign exit.
infra.inboundsDesc: Inbounds define which protocols (VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks) your server offers. Add them here — no JSON needed.
infra.inboundRestart: Saving restarts the core (a few seconds of downtime).
infra.hostsDesc: Hosts control the domain, SNI and TLS used in the config links your users get. Use {SERVER_IP} or {USERNAME} as placeholders.
infra.noHost: No host configured — links use the node address.
infra.xrayUpgradeConfirm: Download and install this Xray release on the node? The node core will restart.
infra.xrayVersionHint: Open Servers → use “Set Xray version” in the Actions column (Xray nodes only, not WireGuard).
infra.tunnelDesc: Relay traffic from an in-country end to a foreign exit end. Either end can be a node or this panel itself.
infra.tunnelHintPanelForeign: This panel runs outside Iran, so it can be the exit. Add or pick an Iran relay node and set the exit to "This panel".
infra.tunnelHintPanelIran: This panel runs inside Iran, so it can be the relay. Set the relay to "This panel" and pick a foreign exit node.
infra.relayEndHint: The in-country side clients connect to.
infra.exitEndHint: The foreign side that reaches the internet.
infra.tunnelBothPanel: Both ends cannot be this panel. At least one end must be a node.
infra.makeTunnelWithPanel: Create a tunnel between this panel and the node
infra.makeTunnelHintIran: This node is in Iran, so it becomes the relay and this panel the exit.
infra.makeTunnelHintForeign: This node is foreign, so it becomes the exit and this panel the relay.
infra.servicesHint: Choose which protocols to enable. SSL for Hysteria2/TUIC is applied automatically during install.
infra.sslHint: Applied over SSH right after the agent registers. Port 80 must be free for Let's Encrypt.
infra.singboxStackHint: Auto-configured after install. Self-signed TLS is used unless you provide LE target + email below.
infra.enableWgOnXray: Also enable WireGuard on this Xray node
infra.enableAwgOnXray: Also enable AmneziaWG on this Xray node
infra.tunnelPortHint: Port used for both the relay listen and exit target (default 443).
infra.autoHint: Enter the server IP and SSH login. The panel installs Docker and the node agent automatically — pick Xray or WireGuard above. No manual setup on the server.
infra.provisionDisabledHint: SSH provisioning is disabled. Enable node_provisioning in System → Features, or fetch a manual install command below.
infra.wgStackHint: WireGuard nodes can run plain WG and AmneziaWG together on different ports (51820 / 51821).
infra.sshPasswordHint: Used once to install the agent; it is not stored.
infra.autoInstallsHint: Installs Docker + node agent with both Xray (v2ray) and WireGuard, enables NET_ADMIN and IP forwarding, then self-registers.
infra.installCommand: Install command (run on the server as root)
infra.provisionQueued: Install started — track progress in the nodes list.
infra.provisionWait: Connecting over SSH, building the agent image, and installing — this can take 5–15 minutes. Please wait.
infra.provisionStarted: Server provisioned — the node will appear shortly.
infra.provisionFailed: Remote install failed. Check SSH credentials, firewall, and that the server is reachable.
infra.provisionManual: Couldn't run remotely — copy the command and run it on the server.
infra.reconnectConfirm: Reconnect node “{{name}}”? Active sessions may briefly drop.

nodes.title: Servers
nodes.subtitle: Machines that run your traffic
nodes.description: Each server (node) runs Xray or WireGuard. Add, remove, reconnect and set Xray versions here — one page, one job.

tunnels.title: Tunnels
tunnels.subtitle: Route traffic from Iran to abroad
tunnels.description: Connect a relay end (Iran) to an exit end (foreign). Either side can be a node or this panel. After creating a tunnel, click Apply to deploy.

hosts.title: Subscription hosts
hosts.subtitle: Domain and address users see
hosts.description: Control domain, SNI and TLS in subscription links. Use {SERVER_IP} and {USERNAME} as placeholders.

xrayPage.title: Xray config
xrayPage.subtitle: Advanced JSON — routing, DNS, outbounds
xrayPage.description: Power users only. Manage inbounds and users from Connectivity; this page is whole-core Xray settings.

wireguard.title: WireGuard
wireguard.subtitle: Native VPN — separate from Xray
wireguard.description: WireGuard works on its own path: add a WG server, create a user with WG enabled, then download the .conf file.
wireguard.notXrayBody: WireGuard does not use Xray inbounds. Use servers with core=wireguard and enable the WG protocol on users.
wireguard.step2: Create a user with WireGuard enabled
wireguard.step3: Download the .conf from the user page
wireguard.awgDescription: Make WireGuard look like random traffic on a per-server basis. Leave blank for plain WireGuard. Requires the amneziawg-go binary on the node.
wireguard.awgNeedsUpgrade: AmneziaWG enabled in panel. Rebuild the node agent (amneziawg-go) on the server.
wireguard.awgNodeOffline: Node offline — reconnect before syncing AmneziaWG.
wireguard.stackRequired: Enable at least plain WireGuard or AmneziaWG

singbox.title: Hysteria2 / TUIC
singbox.subtitle: QUIC protocols via sing-box
singbox.description: Enable Hysteria2 and TUIC on connected servers. Users need the hysteria2 or tuic protocol; subscription links are issued per token.
singbox.notXrayBody: These protocols run on the node's sing-box engine (alongside Xray or WireGuard). TLS certificate files must exist on the server at the paths you configure.
singbox.configHint: Place TLS cert/key on the node (e.g. /var/lib/nexuspanel-node/tls/). Save pushes users to sing-box.
singbox.leHint: Use a DNS domain (A record → server) or a public IP. Port 80 must be free for HTTP-01. IP certs are short-lived (~6 days) and auto-renew via cron.
singbox.leRequired: Target, email, and SSH password are required
singbox.stackRequired: Enable at least Hysteria2 or TUIC
singbox.tlsRequired: Certificate and key paths are required
singbox.nodeOffline: Node offline — reconnect before traffic works.
singbox.noNodes: No servers yet. Add a server first.
singbox.setupFirstBody: All connected servers are listed below. Enable Hysteria2 or TUIC and save to push the first config.

dedip.title: Dedicated IPs
dedip.subtitle: Static IP pool for Trader-profile users
dedip.description: Pin a fixed public IP to a user so their exit address never changes. Used by the Trader client-app profile.
dedip.assignHint: Picks the next free IP from the pool
dedip.empty: Pool is empty — add an IP above.
dedip.flagOffBody: Enable the 'client_api' feature flag in System → Feature flags to manage dedicated IPs.
dedip.releaseConfirm: Release the dedicated IP assigned to “{{username}}”?

copilot.title: Copilot
copilot.greeting: Hi {{name}} — I'm right here with you.
copilot.lead: Pick what you want to set up and I'll walk you through it, step by step.
copilot.footnote: I watch your panel and tick steps off as you finish them.
copilot.autoDetect: I'll detect this automatically when it's done.

quickstart.title: Quick start
quickstart.desc: Go from an empty panel to a working subscription.
quickstart.s_configure_b: Give your panel a title and turn on the modules you need. You can change this anytime.
quickstart.s_server_b: A server (node) is where traffic runs. Use auto-install: paste the IP and SSH password and I'll set everything up.
quickstart.s_inbound_b: An inbound is the protocol your server exposes — VLESS + Reality on 443 is a great default.
quickstart.s_user_b: A user gets a data limit, an expiry and a subscription link to share.
quickstart.s_share_b: Open the user, copy the subscription URL or QR, and send it to your customer. That's it!

tunnel.title: Set up a tunnel
tunnel.desc: Connect Iran to a foreign exit server.
tunnel.s_exit_b: Add a node outside Iran with the Xray core — auto-install or manual connect.
tunnel.s_tunnel_b: On Tunnels, pick relay (Iran) and exit (foreign). Either end can be this panel or a node.
tunnel.s_apply_b: After saving, hit Apply so the config deploys on both ends.

wg.title: Set up WireGuard
wg.desc: Offer fast, native WireGuard configs to your users.
wg.s_node_b: Add a server with the WireGuard core. The agent manages the wg interface for you.
wg.s_user_b: Create a user and enable the WireGuard protocol — keys and the peer IP are generated automatically.
wg.s_share_b: Open the user and download the WireGuard .conf (or share the subscription). Import it in the WireGuard app.

v2ray.title: Set up v2ray (Xray)
v2ray.desc: Classic VLESS / VMess / Trojan / Shadowsocks configs.
v2ray.s_node_b: Add a server with the Xray core — auto-install handles Docker and the agent.
v2ray.s_inbound_b: Add a VLESS + Reality inbound on 443 — the most resilient default today.
v2ray.s_user_b: Create a user, pick the inbound, set a data limit and expiry.
v2ray.s_share_b: Copy the subscription URL or QR from the user and send it. Works with v2rayNG, Streisand, Hiddify and more.

auto.title: Auto-add a server
auto.desc: Turn a bare server into a node with one SSH login.
auto.s_explain_b: Paste the server IP and SSH password. I install Docker, the node agent (Xray + WireGuard), enable NET_ADMIN and IP forwarding, and register it to your server list — no manual steps.

firstuser.title: Create your first user
firstuser.desc: Give someone access in under a minute.
firstuser.s_user_b: Set a username, a data limit and an expiry. Pick the protocols they can use.
firstuser.s_share_b: Open the user, copy the subscription link or QR, and send it.

inbounds.title: Inbounds
inbounds.subtitle: Inbound connections — 3x-ui style
inbounds.description: All Xray inbound protocols: VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks, Hysteria2, WireGuard, AmneziaWG, HTTP/SOCKS, TUN, dokodemo and more.
inbounds.allProtocolsBody: Every protocol supported by Xray 26 is available here — product proxies (user subscription) and advanced listeners (Hysteria2, AmneziaWG, WireGuard, HTTP, SOCKS, TUN, dokodemo).
inbounds.tunHint: Creates a virtual TUN device. Advanced — edit extra fields in JSON if needed.
inbounds.productHintBody: Users connect via VLESS, VMess, Trojan, or Shadowsocks only. WireGuard → Servers → WireGuard tab. Hysteria2/TUIC → Servers → H2 tab. dokodemo tunnels → Tunnels tab (auto-created).
inbounds.expertProtocolsHint: HTTP/SOCKS and dokodemo appear only in expert mode (System settings).
inbounds.emptyDesc: No inbounds configured. Add one when you're ready — e.g. VLESS + Reality on 443.
inbounds.realityPublicKeyHint: Auto-filled by Generate; share this with clients.
inbounds.fallbackHint: Serve multiple protocols on one port (e.g. VLESS + a web server on 443).
inbounds.fallbackDestHint: Port number or host:port to fall back to
inbounds.proxyAuthHint: Auth is managed via panel users; use advanced JSON for custom accounts.
inbounds.advancedWarnBody: Panel users cannot be assigned here. dokodemo = tunnel relay (Tunnels tab). wireguard / amneziawg = Xray WG inbound (not native panel WG/AWG). hysteria = Xray Hysteria2 inbound (distinct from sing-box H2 on nodes).
inbounds.amneziaInboundHint: Stored as wireguard in Xray config. Obfuscation params (Salamander, etc.) — edit in JSON tab or use native AmneziaWG on the WireGuard node tab.
inbounds.ss2022RestartHint: SS-2022 user changes require a core restart (no hot-sync).

xray.basicsDesc: Log level and optional access/error log paths.
xray.inboundsDesc: Like 3x-ui: protocol, port, transport, TLS, Reality, and sniffing — no raw JSON.
xray.outboundsDesc: Where traffic exits: DIRECT (freedom), BLOCK (blackhole), proxy chaining (VLESS/VMess/Trojan/SS/SOCKS/HTTP), or WireGuard/WARP.
xray.warpDesc: Paste your registered WARP secretKey, addresses and reserved values. The endpoint and peer public key are pre-filled for Cloudflare WARP.
xray.routingDesc: Rule order matters. Put specific rules above general ones.
xray.warpRoutingWarnBody: Routing all traffic through WARP adds latency and needs DNS plus a Cloudflare bypass rule (endpoint must connect via DIRECT). Empty DNS or missing bypass often causes drops and slowness.
xray.outboundTagDisabled: Ignored while a balancer tag is set
xray.balancerTagHint: Route to a balancer defined under routing.balancers (overrides outbound tag).
xray.inboundTagsHint: Tags from inbounds defined in Connection → Inbounds. Create Hysteria2 or AmneziaWG inbounds there first, then save.
xray.routingMissingInboundsTitle: Hysteria2 / AmneziaWG not in Xray config
xray.routingMissingInboundsBody: Routing matches inbound tags from the Xray config. Add Hysteria2 or AmneziaWG inbounds below, then save — they will appear in the tag list and routing will work.
xray.noRulesHint: No rules yet — e.g. geoip:private → BLOCK
xray.ruleTagHint: Optional name to identify this rule in logs/API.
xray.vlessRouteHint: Ports forced over VLESS routing (rarely needed).
xray.protocolHint: Requires sniffing enabled on the inbound.
xray.ipHint: Destination IP — distinct from Source IPs.
xray.attrsHint: Match sniffed HTTP header metadata, e.g. :method = GET.
xray.dnsDesc: DNS servers Xray uses for resolution.
xray.dnsAdvancedServersHint: {{count}} advanced server object(s) are kept as-is. Edit them in the Advanced JSON tab.
xray.dnsHostsHint: domain: ip — static overrides. Comma-separate multiple IPs.
xray.jsonDesc: Power users only. Invalid JSON will be rejected on save.
xray.tagPortConflict: Tag or port already in use

outbounds.emptyDesc: Add DIRECT, BLOCK, DNS, proxy outbounds, or WARP — like 3x-ui.
outbounds.importFailed: Could not parse link — supported: vmess, vless, trojan, ss, hysteria2
outbounds.jsonHint: Advanced fields (noises, finalmask, hysteria, etc.) can be edited here. Form tab changes merge with preserved JSON keys.
outbounds.tcpMasksHint: Advanced TCP masks — edit in JSON tab
outbounds.pingTcpHint: TCP reachability (server port open). Click to ping again.
outbounds.dialerProxyHint: Send this outbound through another outbound tag (proxy chaining, e.g. WARP over proxy).
outbounds.amneziaJsonHint: Saved as Xray wireguard outbound. Use the JSON tab for Salamander/obfuscation (finalmask) fields.

tagError.comma: Comma is not allowed in tag

warp.title: Cloudflare WARP
warp.about: Cloudflare WARP routes traffic through Cloudflare's network using WireGuard — useful to hide your server IP or reach geo-blocked services. Register once, then route traffic to the warp outbound via routing rules.
warp.notRegistered: No WARP device registered on this server yet.
warp.licenseHint: Optional — paste a WARP+ license to upgrade this device.
warp.outboundPresent: An outbound “{{tag}}” already exists in the config.
warp.outboundMissing: No warp outbound in the config yet — add one and save.
warp.confirmDelete: Delete the stored WARP credentials? You can register again later.

resellers.title: Resellers & Brand
resellers.subtitle: Reseller logins, white-label tenants and branding
resellers.description: Create reseller accounts with username and password so they can sign in and manage their own users. Tenants (optional, advanced) add white-label isolation. Branding customizes logo and colors on subscription pages.
resellers.subAccountsHint: Sub-resellers sign in with their own credentials and manage users under your workspace limits.
resellers.commissionHint: Share of your sub-reseller's wallet charges credited to you.
resellers.accountsHint: Each account gets a username and password. The reseller opens the same panel URL as you, signs in, and can create users under their quota.
resellers.loginUsernameHint: Used at the panel login screen
resellers.newPasswordPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep current password
resellers.myNodesHint: Nodes you provision appear here. Reconnect or remove failed installs.
resellers.brandingDesc: Customize how your panel and subscription pages look to your customers.
resellers.provisionDesc: Provision a node on your own server via SSH. The panel installs the agent and connects it automatically.
resellers.manualMode: Manual install — copy the command below

automation.title: Automation
automation.subtitle: Rules, workflows and plugins
automation.description: Make the panel do things on its own. Rules react to events (e.g. notify when a user runs out of data). Workflows chain multiple actions. Plugins extend the panel with integrations like Telegram or webhooks.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Usage trends and traffic intelligence
analytics.description: Understand who is using your network and how. Top users by traffic, heavy hitters that may need a bigger plan, and exhaustion risk for users about to hit their limit — everything you need to grow revenue and spot abuse.
analytics.routingHint: Pick a strategy and load nodes ordered best-first.
analytics.runHint: Press “Run analysis” to scan traffic patterns

billing.title: Billing
billing.subtitle: Plans, invoices and wallet
billing.usageDisabled: GB usage billing is disabled. Set a rate per GB under System → Commercial or Billing → Settings.
billing.usageByoDiscount: {{pct}}% discount on traffic via your own nodes.
billing.topUpHint: Pay via the selected gateway. Balance updates immediately after confirmation.
billing.creditAmountHint: Minor currency units (e.g. cents). Credited to reseller wallet.
billing.resellerWalletHint: Wallet is topped up by the platform owner. Contact support if balance is low.
billing.plansReadOnly: You can view plans but not edit them with your current role.
billing.invoiceUserHint: Optional — invoice is created for this admin username
billing.payConfirm: Mark invoice #{{id}} as paid? This is a financial action.

system.title: System
system.subtitle: Configuration, security and maintenance
system.description: Owner-only controls. Toggle feature flags to enable or disable whole modules, take backups before risky operations, issue API keys for automation, and tweak appearance settings that affect every admin.
system.restoreConfirm: Restore this backup? Existing SQLite data will be replaced.
system.keyOnceWarning: Copy this key now — it will not be shown again.
system.expertModeHint: Shows advanced menu items (raw Xray config, extra options).
system.aboutText: NexusPanel is a modern, multi-tenant control plane for proxy infrastructure.
system.cannotDeleteSudo: Sudo accounts can only be removed via CLI
system.updatesUpToDate: You are on the latest version (v{{version}})
system.updateConfirm: Install v{{to}}? Current version is v{{from}}. A backup will be created first.
system.updateDone: Update complete. Version v{{version}} is now installed.
system.updateFailed: Update could not finish. Try again or restart the panel manually.
system.updatesBreaking: This release may include breaking changes — review notes before installing.
system.whatsNewEmpty: This version is installed. Enjoy the improvements!
system.xrayTabDesc: Pick a GitHub release to install on this panel host or on a specific node.
system.xrayAlsoInInfra: You can also use Infrastructure → Nodes → “Set Xray version” per node.
system.restartCoreConfirm: Restart the panel Xray core now? Active sessions may drop briefly.
system.jwtRotateHint: Rotating the JWT secret invalidates ALL existing subscription links; every user must fetch a new link.
system.jwtRotateConfirm: Rotate the subscription secret? ALL existing subscription links will stop working immediately.
system.jwtRotated: Secret rotated — users need new subscription links

commercial.hint: All commercial settings are stored in the database. Changes apply immediately; restart the panel service if you change the usage billing job interval.
